title: Concept: Wasabi bucket listing in a response
description: An object listing served from a Wasabi endpoint in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The listing names the archive objects a bank keeps for audit and retention, which is a target list for anyone hunting unencrypted exports.
applicability: Deployments that render an object listing served from a Wasabi endpoint into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The listing names the archive objects a bank keeps for audit and retention, which is a target list for anyone hunting unencrypted exports.
